Results.ReviewText:
I've had our new Weber grill for about a month now and so far, everything I've cooked on it has come out prefect. Our previous grill(s) was a charcoal grill and to be truthful, I really liked cooking with charcoal. When our last charcoal grill was wearing out (not a Weber kettle grill) I started thinking about how often I was having issues with the coals burning down before the meat was finished or how often I was getting flare ups. I decided to look at gas grills and after reading a number of reviews I decided to try the Weber Spirit II grill. 

I've cooked probably a dozen or more meals on it so far with all varieties of proteins and so far everything has turned out perfect - in both proper doneness as well as how the meat looked (wife loves the sear marks!). I'm very happy with our purchase and with the apparent quality of the grill's construction I expect this grill will gives us many years of great meals.

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this grill to replace my old one. I’ve used it a dozen times so far and haven’t burned a steak or a burger yet. This grill is amazing. Well worth the price compared to other brands. I’m a Weber fan for life.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: My grill was bought by my wife for my Birthday and after the 1st time using it I was amazed at how easy it was and fast to cook on.  I always was a Weber Charcoal guy. I love both of them and would never chsnge
Results.Title: Love my Spirit I gas grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace my old Weber that I purchased ten years ago. The reason I replaced my old one is that I passed that one on to my son who continues to use it. I expect this one will also last for a long period of time.
Results.Title: Exactly what I wanted in a grill.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I've used this grill a few times now and have had no major issues. It takes a little longer to ignite than I'm used to but it ignites. I usually turn the grate over after ever couple of uses to make sure they stay clean and found that no fume oven cleaner works great for cleaning the tops of the drip pans.
Results.Title: Great Gas Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This grill is well constructed. Quick preheat time, The temperature stays very consistent inside the grill while lid is closed which is very beneficial for long cook times. Large enough to feed a family of five with several different food items cooking at once. Very happy that I chose this weber spirit E-310
-Ash
Results.Title: Simplicity is perfect!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This is my second weber grill in 3 years, we recently moved long distance and unfortunately we could not take our grill with us. The reason we purchased another weber was the warranty and the quality construction.
On my old grills I was overhauling them every 1-2 years because of rotting burners or disintegrating flavor bars.
My first weber was almost like new after 3 years.
Results.Title: Great quality!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I debated whether this grill was worth the money. So far, it's been worth it,
Results.Title: Good Decision

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Our new Webber cooks steak perfectly!
We set it on high, brown the meat and then turn to medium for a minute or two—perfect meat!
Our prior grill had 700 degrees or off
Results.Title: Cooks Steak perfectly

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I like the small, simply, sturdy design. I just hope that the burners don't rust out anytime soon.
Results.Title: So far so great!  Let's see how long it lasts.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Purchased this grill about 3 months ago. First time owning a Weber.  I love the grill.  The size, functionality and results are perfect.  It cooks everything perfectly.  I just wish i purchased this years ago.
Results.Title: Perfect Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Used it a couple of times and performed great. It is made with quality parts.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Overall okay but could be heavier lid! Happy with grilling steaks, hamburgers, etc

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
